diagnosis: The Prisma $extends client extension injects a tenant filter only onto top-level Customer operations. If a developer uses nested includes or if records have orphaned or shared foreign keys, or queries customer by ID where customer has payment methods, the extension fails to apply authorization filters recursively to related child models like PaymentMethod, exposing customer credit card tokens across tenants.
exploit_request:
GET /api/customers/cust_corp_beta_9918/vault HTTP/1.1
Host: billing-vault.saas.internal:8088
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_alpha_token>
Accept: application/json
